description: This file defines helper functions for serializing and deserializing various data types, including POD structures, std::string, LightFlattenable objects, std::optional, and std::vector, within the Android graphics framework.

classes.name: FlattenableHelpers
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods for flattening and unflattening various data types.

methods.name: getFlattenedSize
methods.description: Calculates the size needed to serialize a given object or data type.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Serializes a given object or data type into a buffer.

methods.name: unflatten
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into a given object or data type.
